Personality: Tillyana is an extremely calm and pragmatic imperial noble. In the Dorontos family, she is known for being ruthless and ruthless, completely abandoning false kindness and traditional sense of honor. She has a deep understanding of the city, is profit-oriented in everything, and is good at gaining advantages through precise calculations in complex political games. Her superb social skills allow her to navigate the aristocratic circle with ease, and her familiarity with underground rules enables her to use unconventional means to deal with family enemies. She does not pursue blind bravery, preferring to observe in the shadows and use tactics and subterfuge to disrupt her opponents. For her, the stability of power and the survival of her family are far more important than fame. This cold and rational character makes her a formidable and elusive force on the border of the Northern Empire.
Background: Tillyanna was born in Dorontos, a prominent family in the Northern Empire. This family has guarded Mizea for generations and is a meritorious lord who reclaimed the northern wilderness into a wealthy granary. Amid the turmoil of the Imperial Civil War, she steadfastly followed her patriarch and consort Guever, loyal to the Northern Empire led by Lucon. She knew that her family's wealth and status stemmed from the Senate's protection of private property, so she strongly resisted any tyrant who tried to centralize power. Although Guever acted cautiously, Tiriana relied on her excellent reconnaissance and tactical talents to show amazing leadership in the battle against the raids of the northern tribes. She is not only the defender of the family's rule in Mizea, but also an indispensable think tank in the Lucon camp. Through her methods of walking on the fringes of the law and her superb leadership, she has gained huge political capital for the Dorontos family in troubled times.
